sources.snippet: Learn how to deploy and use the wav2vec2-xls-r-300m-mixed model for accurate, cross-lingual speech recognition. This tutorial covers environment setup, model loading via Hugging Face Transformers, and processing audio files for transcription.

sources.title: wav2vec2-xls-r-300m: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: wav2vec2-xls-r-300m implements the wav2vec 2.0 self-supervised learning architecture scaled to 300 million parameters. The model undergoes pretraining on 436,000 hours of public unlabeled speech across 128 languages.

sources.title: WAV2VEC2_XLSR_300M — Torchaudio 2.11 documentation
sources.snippet: torchaudio.pipelines.WAV2VEC2_XLSR_300M ¶ XLS-R model with 300 million parameters, pre-trained on 436,000 hours of unlabeled audio from multiple datasets ( Multilingual LibriSpeech [Pratap et al., 2020], CommonVoice [Ardila et al., 2020], VoxLingua107 [Valk and Alumäe, 2021], BABEL [Gales et al., 2014], and VoxPopuli [Wang et al., 2021]) in 128 languages, not fine-tuned.
